title: The Getting started dialog keeps its Close (x) and Hide buttons inside the card at 360 and 390 px
steps: S1: Run packages/ui/tracy-onboard/test/e2e/top-row-fits.test.mjs with CHROME_CDP=http://127.0.0.1:9222 (chrome-watch): it renders the real OnboardView with the real stylesheet at 360, 390 and 1440 px, first run and reopened from the menu, and measures .tv-ob-close and .tv-ob-hide against .tv-ob-dialog.
S2 (stand, optional): sign in as a brand-new account at 360x800 and read the boxes of .tv-ob-close and .tv-ob-dialog.
expect: S1: all six tests pass: Close ends at least 8 px inside the dialog's right edge and inside the viewport; Hide starts inside the dialog.
evidence: Dev 12/10/2026 (develop e5ea4dd849) at 360 px: .tv-ob-close at x=371..397, dialog 24..336, viewport 360.
fence: tracy-onboard onboard.css: below 620 px .tv-ob-hide-label is hidden, the button keeps aria-label and title
